reading.title: Making the Bedroom Ready
reading.text: Maya makes the bed before work. She spreads a sheet over the mattress and places the duvet and blanket on top. Her phone stays on the nightstand. She hangs a jacket in the wardrobe, puts clean clothes in the dresser, and sits at the desk to check her plans.
